sources.title: June 2026 Piracy and armed robbery report
sources.text: While underway, 5 perpetrators armed with a knife and a gun-like object were sighted in the engine room. Ship's general alarm was activated, deck lights switched on and all crew mustered. A search was conducted with no further sighting of the perpetrators onboard. All crew were accounted for and were safe. Some engine spares were stolen. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch carried out to warn vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the Singapore Strait. Republic of Singapore Navy (RSN) and Police Coast Guard (PCG) were notified of the incident. PCG boarded the vessel and conducted a security search. No perpetrators were found on board. Information was shared with the Indonesia authorities
